requirements.requirement: There is an Indian author who was promoted from associate professor to professor in 2022 at the same university where the author completed undergraduate and graduate degrees.
The author pursued a PhD abroad at a Canadian university under the guidance of an Iranian professor.
The Iranian professor who guided the author's PhD dreamt of becoming a writer but switched to mathematics at the end of high school, and received their doctorate in Minnesota.
The author published a book connecting mathematics to an ancient technique for liberation 20 years after completing the PhD.
The author published a journal article on a topic similar to that book six years after publishing the book.
The requested answer is the title of that journal article.
